description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non material amendment in connection with planning permission ref. 21/0585/F, dated 28/04/2022, for the 'Demolition of existing buildings and construction of a mixed use, residential (Use Class C3), education (Use Class F.1) and commercial (Use Classes E/F.1/F.2) development together with associated landscaping, play space, access, refuse and recycling storage, car and cycle parking, public realm improvements and associated works' to allow amendments of the development including:  - Alterations to the landscape and cycle parking layout to the front of Block A to provide street trees in raised planter, and changes to the tree specimen.
